name: Spinner
purpose: Present visual loading without owning request state or announcements.
useWhen: A task needs a compact indeterminate visual indicator.

avoidWhen.condition: A named progress task exposes completion or a range.

composition: Use responsive size for breakpoint-specific diameters; inherit follows typography.
Use asChild for one passive SVG/artwork element, never a control or focusable subtree. Artwork owns its stroke; Spinner supplies size, color and motion without ring paint.
Pair a decorative Spinner with visible status text; keep Button loading and Toast announcements on their existing owners.

rules.statement: Keep Spinner decorative unless a standalone graphic needs an authored label; do not add a duplicate live region.
Load styles.css or core.css plus spinner.css.

commonMistakes.mistake: Replacing ProgressCircle or a button's busy semantics with Spinner.
commonMistakes.correction: Keep the semantic owner and use Spinner only for visual feedback.

validation: Check square geometry, normal/reduced motion, forced colors, RTL, light/dark and one accessible name.
